title: Zillow Says Your House Is Worth More? Show Me the Data! | Central Texas Realtor
description:
Think your home is worth more because Zillow says so? 🤔 But where’s the paperwork and real market data behind that number?

Online estimates don’t always reflect the actual market value of your home. A local Central Texas Realtor studies real comps, buyer demand, and neighborhood trends to determine the true value of your property.

If you’re planning to sell your home, make sure you’re using real data—not just online estimates.
